newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi returns refugees to Kabila's Congo, Rwanda.
newsitem.headline: Malawi returns refugees to Kabila's Congo, Rwanda.

text.p: Malawi would send more than 1,000 refugees home to Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, government officials said on Tuesday.

The office responsible for relief and rehabilitation said in a statement there was considerable peace and stability in the two countries and the government had decided to repatriate the refugees, who have lived in Malawi for up to three years.
It said 746 Rwandan refugees would be sent home before the end of August. They would immediately be followed by 504 refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, formerly Zaire.
